headline: KCR @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 3.02 at CIN 5.08, with a projected total of 8.10. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: KCR moved -1.64 runs while CIN moved +0.09, changing the projected margin by -1.73 runs. The projected total fell -1.55, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Luinder Avila has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Maikel Garcia, Nathaniel Lowe, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler Tolbert, Matt McLain because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
